description: This file defines the interface for a player information module, including enums, callback types, and function declarations for managing player state, codecs, resolution, Dolby modes, and notifications.

methods.name: playerinfo_register_operational_state_change_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for operational state changes of the player instance.

methods.name: playerinfo_unregister_operational_state_change_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered operational state change callback.

methods.name: playerinfo_register_dolby_sound_mode_updated_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for Dolby sound mode updates.

methods.name: playerinfo_unregister_dolby_sound_mode_updated_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered Dolby sound mode update callback.

methods.name: playerinfo_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name (callsign) of the player instance.

methods.name: playerinfo_playback_resolution
methods.description: Gets the current video playback resolution.

methods.name: playerinfo_is_audio_equivalence_enabled
methods.description: Checks if loudness equivalence is enabled.

methods.name: playerinfo_audio_codecs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of audio codecs used by the player.

methods.name: playerinfo_video_codecs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of video codecs used by the player.

methods.name: playerinfo_is_dolby_atmos_supported
methods.description: Checks if Dolby Atmos is supported.

methods.name: playerinfo_enable_atmos_output
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos audio output.

methods.name: playerinfo_dispose
methods.description: Closes the cached connection if it exists.
